For a partial refund use `refund-payment`; for known uncaptured payments use `cancel-payment`. Received means request acceptance only.

functions.name: send-terminal-request
functions.description: Send an exact structured Terminal API command to a payment device, choosing asynchronous dispatch acknowledgment or a synchronous Terminal API result.

merchantId.description: Merchant account code authorized to address the device.

deviceId.description: Terminal model/serial ID or Mobile SDK installation ID; must match the command's POIID.

additionalProperties.description: An ordinary JSON value, preserving nested values and domain keys.

request.description: Exact structured Terminal API command object; ordinary JSON, not serialized JSON text. Its header POIID must match deviceId. Intended for protocol-level integrations requiring full command control.

responseMode.description: async returns dispatch acknowledgment; sync returns a Terminal API response within the callable deadline.

oneOf.description: A JSON string, including Unicode text.

items.description: An ordinary JSON value, preserving nested values and domain keys.

oneOf.description: An ordered array of JSON values.

additionalProperties.description: An ordinary JSON value, preserving nested values and domain keys.

oneOf.description: An object with domain keys and JSON values.

FunctionInput_adyen_sendterminalrequest.description: A device-addressed Terminal API command and the desired acknowledgment or result mode.

responseMode.description: Response mode used for this command.

dispatched.description: For async, true establishes Adyen sent the command to an online device; it does not establish payment success. For sync, true only after a Terminal API response is obtained.

response.description: Parsed Terminal API synchronous response, or parsed immediate asynchronous acknowledgment if one is supplied; omitted for an empty acknowledgment body.

oneOf.description: A JSON string, including Unicode text.

items.description: An ordinary JSON value, preserving nested values and domain keys.

oneOf.description: An ordered array of JSON values.

additionalProperties.description: An ordinary JSON value, preserving nested values and domain keys.

oneOf.description: An object with domain keys and JSON values.

FunctionOutput_adyen_sendterminalrequest.description: Dispatch acknowledgment or the exact synchronous Terminal API result, not a payment approval guarantee.

tags.instructions: Use only when you intentionally need Terminal API protocol control and already have a valid command. Supply the merchant and device IDs from your terminal inventory. async returns dispatch acknowledgment, not payment success; the result goes to your existing notification endpoint. sync waits for the device result. Do not replay uncertain financial commands. This tool does not register notification endpoints.

functions.name: update-payment-authorised-amount
functions.description: Increase or decrease the total authorised amount of an uncaptured payment, optionally using synchronous authorisation-adjustment data.

paymentPspReference.description: Adyen reference of the original uncaptured payment.

merchantAccount.description: Merchant account that processed the payment.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code using Adyen's currency definition.

value.description: Exact integer in Adyen minor units; no floating-point conversion or currency exchange is performed.

amount.description: New total authorised amount, not an increment; must use the original currency.

reference.description: Your reference for this adjustment request; omitted if absent.

industryUsage.description: Applicable business reason for the adjustment, when required.

adjustAuthType.description: Who initiates this adjustment; omission leaves the provider's normal behavior.

idempotencyKey.description: Identifier of this logical adjustment; reuse only for an identical retry.

adjustAuthorisationData.description: Opaque data from the payment response, event, or previous adjustment for synchronous adjustment.

FunctionInput_adyen_updatepaymentauthori.description: An uncaptured payment and the new total authorised amount to request.

pspReference.description: Adyen reference of this adjustment request.

paymentPspReference.description: Adyen reference of the original payment.

merchantAccount.description: Merchant account processing the adjustment.

value.description: Exact amount in Adyen minor units.

amount.description: New total amount reported for the request.

status.description: Synchronous authorisation/refusal, or asynchronous request receipt; received is not authorisation.

reference.description: Your adjustment reference, if returned.

adjustAuthorisationData.description: Replacement opaque data for the next synchronous adjustment, if returned.

FunctionOutput_adyen_updatepaymentauthor.description: The adjustment request result, preserving asynchronous receipt and synchronous refusal.

tags.instructions: Use the original payment PSP reference and merchant account. amount is the new total, not a delta, and currency must match the original authorisation. Captured payments cannot be adjusted. Supply the latest adjustAuthorisationData for the synchronous flow and retain the returned replacement value. A received status is only request acceptance.
